message.skyabyss.depths.climb: To climb the chain, crouch and right-click.
message.skyabyss.depths.descend: You fell into depth %s. The dark is thick here.
message.skyabyss.depths.fell: You fell through the floor of the depths. You wake at the last lantern.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.bea: The side ledges blink out and back on every second and a half.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.cha: Stones fall straight onto a person, after a warning ring.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.cop: Foes that spawn lean toward past shadows and nameless shapes.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.cru: Stand on a side ledge for two seconds and it crumbles; it returns after ten.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.dar: The dark rises from the bottom, one block every twelve seconds.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.fog: Foes far from any light vanish from sight.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.hea: Falling gets faster. Climbing stays the same.
message.skyabyss.depths.gimmick_note.lig: The wall lamps go out a quarter at a time, every twenty seconds.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.chain_: Chains are strung like a net; you drop down through its gaps.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.dry_we: A mud-brick well shaft rises at the center of a silent well.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.floati: A graveyard in the air, each ledge with its own stone.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.hollow: Faint lights scattered on the ceiling stand in for stars.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.invert: A forest hanging from the ceiling; the path winds beneath the roots.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.lamp_h: Many lamps, yet black mouths in the walls eat every light.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.mirror: Black mirrors run around the walls like bands in the dark.
message.skyabyss.depths.kind_note.pulse_: Veins on the walls redden in a steady beat, like a breathing cave.
message.skyabyss.depths.milestone: Passed the depth %s milestone below the heart. Your levels rise.
message.skyabyss.depths.milestone_group: Your group passed the depth %s milestone below the heart.
message.skyabyss.depths.modifier_note.fi: Foes gain one step of strength.
message.skyabyss.depths.modifier_note.mo: The spawn cap is one and a half times higher.
message.skyabyss.depths.modifier_note.ri: Foes sometimes drop an extra abyss material.
message.skyabyss.depths.not_yet: The depth below is not formed yet. Wait a moment.
message.skyabyss.depths.rare_note.past_g: A stone bier and a barrel of a past self's belongings.
message.skyabyss.depths.rare_note.treasu: Two chests at the end of a side bridge, full of old loot.
message.skyabyss.depths.rare_note.warden: A split heart pillar and a chest: a remnant of the warden.
message.skyabyss.depths.rest: You can rest here. If you fall, you wake here.
message.skyabyss.depths.returned: Back in the heart room. This dive's record stops here.
